split.answerPanel: If the proxy gate passes, freeze a new answer panel from quarterly current-state cases excluding lifecycle-adaptive-e2e-v1.1 case ids.

eventSemantics.deletePredecessor: Emit no successor for a candidate invalidated by the latest eligible delete event.
eventSemantics.deleteSuccessor: Treat the write-time deletion utterance itself as a tombstone and do not inject it.
eventSemantics.updatePredecessor: Redirect to the latest eligible update successor exactly as V1 does.
eventSemantics.refill: Continue through the existing Base candidate pool until five valid candidates are emitted or the bounded pool is exhausted.
eventSemantics.mixedLatestKinds: Fail the whole call and return Base rather than guessing.

evaluation.primarySubset: quarterly questions with at least one obsolete atom and task in {remembering, recommending}

claimBoundary: The proxy gate can qualify answer testing only. It cannot establish answer quality, programming-task utility, or promotion over V1.
